## 2

I understand why some space images might seem suspicious—images can be edited, and institutions should be questioned. But the evidence for a round Earth doesn’t depend on trusting NASA or any single organization. Ships disappear hull-first over the horizon, different stars are visible from different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and people can circumnavigate the planet. Satellites, GPS, weather forecasting, and independent space agencies also rely on the same spherical-Earth model. Taken together, these observations are much better explained by a roughly spherical Earth than by a flat one.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky.

Violet light scatters even more, but our eyes are less sensitive to violet, and some violet light is absorbed high in the atmosphere. That is why the sky usually looks blue. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering much of the blue light away. The reds and oranges are left more visible, making those colors appear in the sky.

雨从傍晚一直下到深夜，细密的水线在路灯下交织成一层朦胧的帘。屋檐不断滴水，落在青石板上，发出清脆而有规律的声响。街上的车辆驶过，车轮卷起浅浅的水花，灯光也被拉成长长的倒影。远处偶尔传来一声关门响，随后又只剩雨声。窗边的人捧着一杯热茶，看雾气慢慢升起，觉得这座喧闹的城市终于安静了下来。
